changeSet.author: paystack
changeSet.comment: Add Per-Customer Discount Usage Report for PostgreSQL

column.name: report_name
column.value: Per-Customer Discount Usage Report

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT COALESCE(da.customer_id, mc.id) AS "Customer ID", COALESCE(mc.display_name, 'Unknown') AS "Customer Name", COALESCE(mc.account_no, 'N/A') AS "Customer Account No", COUNT(DISTINCT da.account_number) AS "Number of Accounts", COUNT(da.id) AS "Number of Discounts", SUM(da.original_amount) AS "Total Original Fees", SUM(da.discount_amount) AS "Total Discounts Applied", SUM(da.final_amount) AS "Total Final Fees", ROUND(SUM(da.discount_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(da.original_amount), 0), 2) AS "Discount Percentage" FROM v_discount_application_report da LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON da.customer_id = mc.id WHERE da.application_date::date BETWEEN '${startDate}'::date AND '${endDate}'::date GROUP BY COALESCE(da.customer_id, mc.id), COALESCE(mc.display_name, 'Unknown'), COALESCE(mc.account_no, 'N/A') ORDER BY SUM(da.discount_amount) DESC

column.name: description
column.value: Per-customer discount usage report showing total discounts applied per customer with account breakdown

changeSet.author: paystack
changeSet.comment: Add Fees Waived Report for PostgreSQL

column.name: report_name
column.value: Fees Waived Report

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT CASE WHEN '${periodType}' = 'monthly' THEN TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'YYYY-MM') WHEN '${periodType}' = 'quarterly' THEN TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'YYYY') || '-Q' || TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'Q') ELSE TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS "Period", SUM(da.discount_amount) AS "Total Fees Waived", COUNT(*) AS "Number of Discounts", da.fee_type_category AS "Fee Type", dr.name AS "Discount Rule" FROM v_discount_application_report da JOIN m_discount_rule dr ON da.discount_rule_id = dr.id WHERE da.application_date::date BETWEEN '${startDate}'::date AND '${endDate}'::date GROUP BY CASE WHEN '${periodType}' = 'monthly' THEN TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'YYYY-MM') WHEN '${periodType}' = 'quarterly' THEN TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'YYYY') || '-Q' || TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'Q') ELSE TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, da.fee_type_category, dr.name ORDER BY "Period" DESC, da.fee_type_category

column.name: description
column.value: Total fees waived per period (daily, monthly, quarterly) with breakdown by fee type and discount rule

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT CASE WHEN '${periodType}' = 'monthly' THEN DATE_FORMAT(da.application_date, '%Y-%m') WHEN '${periodType}' = 'quarterly' THEN CONCAT(YEAR(da.application_date), '-Q', QUARTER(da.application_date)) ELSE DATE(da.application_date) END AS "Period", SUM(da.discount_amount) AS "Total Fees Waived", COUNT(*) AS "Number of Discounts", da.fee_type_category AS "Fee Type", dr.name AS "Discount Rule" FROM v_discount_application_report da JOIN m_discount_rule dr ON da.discount_rule_id = dr.id WHERE DATE(da.application_date) BETWEEN DATE('${startDate}') AND DATE('${endDate}') GROUP BY CASE WHEN '${periodType}' = 'monthly' THEN DATE_FORMAT(da.application_date, '%Y-%m') WHEN '${periodType}' = 'quarterly' THEN CONCAT(YEAR(da.application_date), '-Q', QUARTER(da.application_date)) ELSE DATE(da.application_date) END, da.fee_type_category, dr.name ORDER BY "Period" DESC, da.fee_type_category

column.name: description
column.value: Total fees waived per period (daily, monthly, quarterly) with breakdown by fee type and discount rule

changeSet.author: paystack
changeSet.comment: Add Rule Utilization Statistics Report for PostgreSQL

column.name: report_name
column.value: Rule Utilization Report

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT dr.id AS "Rule ID", dr.name AS "Rule Name", dr.rule_type AS "Rule Type", COUNT(da.id) AS "Times Fired", COALESCE(SUM(da.discount_amount), 0) AS "Total Discount Amount", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(da.discount_amount), 2), 0) AS "Average Discount Amount", MIN(da.application_date) AS "First Application", MAX(da.application_date) AS "Last Application", CASE WHEN COUNT(da.id) = 0 THEN 'Never Used' WHEN COUNT(da.id) < 10 THEN 'Low Usage' WHEN COUNT(da.id) < 100 THEN 'Medium Usage' ELSE 'High Usage' END AS "Usage Status" FROM m_discount_rule dr LEFT JOIN v_discount_application_report da ON dr.id = da.discount_rule_id AND (da.application_date IS NULL OR (da.application_date::date BETWEEN '${startDate}'::date AND '${endDate}'::date)) WHERE dr.is_active = true GROUP BY dr.id, dr.name, dr.rule_type ORDER BY COUNT(da.id) DESC, dr.name

column.name: description
column.value: Rule utilization statistics showing which rules are most/least used with performance metrics

changeSet.comment: Add Complete Audit Trail Report for PostgreSQL

column.name: report_name
column.value: Discount Audit Trail

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT da.id AS "Application ID", COALESCE(mc.account_no, 'N/A') AS "Customer ID", da.account_number AS "Account Number", da.transaction_id AS "Transaction ID", da.application_date AS "Timestamp", da.original_amount AS "Original Fee Amount", da.discount_amount AS "Discounted Fee Amount", da.final_amount AS "Final Fee Amount", da.triggered_conditions AS "Condition(s) Triggered", da.discount_type AS "Discount Type", dr.name AS "Discount Rule Name", dr.rule_type AS "Rule Type", da.charge_name AS "Charge Name", da.fee_type_category AS "Fee Type", da.created_by AS "Created By User ID", da.created_on_utc AS "Created On", da.last_modified_by AS "Last Modified By User ID", da.last_modified_on_utc AS "Last Modified On" FROM v_discount_application_report da LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON da.customer_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN m_discount_rule dr ON da.discount_rule_id = dr.id WHERE da.application_date::date BETWEEN '${startDate}'::date AND '${endDate}'::date AND ('${accountNumber}' = '' OR da.account_number = '${accountNumber}') AND ('${discountType}' = '' OR da.discount_type = '${discountType}') ORDER BY da.application_date DESC

column.name: description
column.value: Complete audit trail with all discount application details including triggered conditions, timestamps, and user information
